_: The KERNEL's own sig-hash and tx-id per corpus shape, its hash:nnote per corpus note, and its hash:lock per corpus lock. Generated — never hand-edited. See vesl-core/crates/vesl-parity-corpus/tests/hoon_rust_parity.rs.

lock-demand.why: a demand: answer inside the window, expiry after it, the round beside the facts

lock-funding.why: the buyer's funding note: a 2-of-2, a 1-of-1 behind a relative minimum, the facts beside a burn, and padding

lock-held.why: a slash's change: a TWO-branch lock, the holder behind a relative minimum

lock-job.why: the job note: a 2-of-2 behind a relative MAXIMUM — a %tim leg no earlier lock of ours set

lock-provider-note.why: the provider note: pay after the window, clawback inside it, the job's facts and its closing's in the reserved branch

lock-reward.why: a slash's reward: a bare 1-of-1 beside the job's facts, two branches

lock-slice.why: a bond slice: two 2-of-2s, a fallback behind the slice's life, and the terms beside a slot that is not a digest

lock-ticket.why: a check's ticket: every deadline an ABSOLUTE height — the first this fleet set

lock-vouch.why: a checker's vouch: pay behind an ABSOLUTE minimum, clawback behind an absolute maximum

note-opaque-notedata.why: an escrow-shaped note: opaque note-data folds into the hash

note-other-origin.why: the same coin landed on another page: the origin page is an operand, and a name-only builder cannot know it

note-plain.why: a plain coin: no note-data — what a funding coin or a change output is

note-typed-lock-notedata.why: a %lock-typed entry — the other NoteDataValue encoding

capture-3out-opaque-notedata.why: the escrow output carries note-data: the digest must see it (S117's positive control)

capture-3out-pinned.why: today's shipped capture, straight out of build_capture_seeds

capture-3out-typed-lock-notedata.why: a %lock-typed entry — the coverage gap nockchain-types' own TODO names

capture-3out-unpinned.why: the pre-row-19 value: what every seed looked like before we pinned output-source

funding-post-2seed-pinned.why: what a buyer's wallet posts: one funding note naming the job's facts, and the change

job-capture-3seed-pinned.why: the escrow flow's capture: the provider note with the job's facts and what its signed closing fixed, the commission, and the buyer's change

single-seed-notedata-manual-jam.why: forces jam_seeds_manual, the encoder the three-seed shapes never reach
